items.caption:
Why do you hear a bang as you fall asleep?
It's exploding head syndrome: a sudden loud noise in your head as you drift off or wake. It's usually painless, and 18% of 211 US college students said they had it at least once. If it's frequent or worrying, talk to a doctor.
Have you ever heard the bang?

items.caption:
Do you dream in color?
In one diary study of 60 people, about 4% of under-25s' dreams were black and white, vs about a quarter for over-55s raised on black-and-white TV. Small study: a link, not proof.
What color do you remember from your last dream?
